info.name: Secunda Task Management API
info.description:
REST API for team task management with role-based access, task history, Redis list caching and SQL analytics.

**Base URL:** `{{baseUrl}}` (default `http://localhost:8080/api/v1`)

**Authentication:** run **Login** first. The test script stores the JWT in `{{token}}`; the collection adds `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` to protected requests. Register and Login are explicitly public.

**Variables:** `teamId`, `taskId`, `taskVersion`, `inviteeId`, `userId` are populated by request test scripts where possible.

**Roles:** owner and admin can edit any task, invite members and view analytics; members can create tasks and edit only tasks they created or are assigned to (assignees may change status only).

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Public endpoints. No bearer token is required.

request.description:
**Register a user** (`POST /api/v1/register`)

Public. Creates a user account and returns the public user representation. The email must be unique.

**Responses**
- `201` user created
- `409` email is already registered
- `422` validation error
- `500` internal error

The test script stores the returned user ID in `{{userId}}`.

**Authenticate and issue a JWT** (`POST /api/v1/login`)

Public. Verifies the email/password pair and returns a bearer token plus the authenticated user.

**Responses**
- `200` authenticated
- `401` invalid email or password
- `422` validation error
- `500` internal error

The test script stores `token` and `user.id` in collection variables.

item.name: Teams
item.description: All endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`. A user sees only teams where they are a member or creator.

request.description:
**Create a team** (`POST /api/v1/teams`)

Bearer required. The current user becomes the team owner.

**Responses**
- `201` team created
- `401` authentication required
- `422` validation error
- `500` internal error

The test script stores the new ID in `{{teamId}}`.

**List current user teams** (`GET /api/v1/teams`)

Bearer required. Returns only teams where the current user is a member or creator. No cross-team data is exposed.

**Responses**
- `200` array of teams
- `401` authentication required
- `500` internal error

**Invite a user to a team** (`POST /api/v1/teams/{id}/invite`)

Bearer required. Only the team owner or an admin may invite. Allowed roles: `admin`, `member`; `owner` cannot be granted through an invite. The invitee must exist.

**Path**
- `id` team ID (`{{teamId}}`)

**Body**
- `user_id` invitee user ID (`{{inviteeId}}`)
- `role` `admin` or `member`

**Responses**
- `204` member invited
- `401` authentication required
- `403` only owner/admin can invite
- `404` invitee user not found
- `409` user is already a member
- `422` validation error or owner role requested
- `500` internal error

item.name: Tasks
item.description: All endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`. Task visibility is membership-based; the list is cached in Redis for 5 minutes per team and filter set.

request.description:
**Create a task** (`POST /api/v1/tasks`)

Bearer required. Any member of the team may create a task. The current user becomes the task creator. The optional assignee must be a member of the same team.

**Body**
- `team_id` target team (`{{teamId}}`)
- `title` 1-255 characters
- `description` optional text
- `assignee_id` optional team member ID (`{{inviteeId}}`)

**Responses**
- `201` task created
- `401` authentication required
- `403` user is not a team member
- `422` validation error or assignee is not a team member
- `500` internal error

The test script stores `taskId` and `taskVersion`. Creation is transactional and records the initial history entry.

**List team tasks** (`GET /api/v1/tasks`)

Bearer required. Requires `team_id` and team membership; tasks from other teams are never returned. The result is cached in Redis for 5 minutes per team and normalized filter set.

**Query**
- `team_id` required
- `status` optional: `todo`, `in_progress`, `done`
- `assignee_id` optional
- `limit` optional, default 20, max 100
- `offset` optional, default 0

**Responses**
- `200` `{ items, total, limit, offset }`
- `400` invalid query parameters
- `401` authentication required
- `403` user is not a team member
- `422` invalid status
- `500` internal error

**Update a task** (`PUT /api/v1/tasks/{id}`)

Bearer required. Permissions:
- owner/admin may edit any task in the team;
- the task creator may edit title, description, status and assignee;
- the assignee may change only status;
- other members cannot edit the task.

Updates are versioned: send the current `version` to avoid lost updates. Every effective change is written to `task_history` in the same transaction, and the team task-list cache generation is invalidated after commit.

**Path**
- `id` task ID (`{{taskId}}`)

**Body** (all fields optional; omitted fields are unchanged)
- `title`, `description`, `status`, `assignee_id`, `version`

**Responses**
- `200` updated task
- `401` authentication required
- `403` insufficient permissions
- `404` task not found
- `409` version conflict
- `422` validation error or no changes
- `500` internal error

The test script refreshes `taskVersion`.

**Get task history** (`GET /api/v1/tasks/{id}/history`)

Bearer required. Only members of the task team can read the ordered change log. Each entry contains the author, timestamp and old/new values for changed fields.

**Path**
- `id` task ID (`{{taskId}}`)

**Responses**
- `200` array of history entries
- `401` authentication required
- `403` user is not a team member
- `404` task not found
- `500` internal error

**Add a task comment** (`POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/comments`)

Bearer required. Only members of the task team can comment. Comments do not change the task version or invalidate the task-list cache.

**Path**
- `id` task ID (`{{taskId}}`)

**Body**
- `content` 1-10000 characters

**Responses**
- `201` comment created
- `401` authentication required
- `403` user is not a team member
- `404` task not found
- `422` validation error
- `500` internal error

The test script stores the new ID in `{{commentId}}`.

**List task comments** (`GET /api/v1/tasks/{id}/comments`)

Bearer required. Only members of the task team can read comments. Results are ordered by creation time.

**Path**
- `id` task ID (`{{taskId}}`)

**Responses**
- `200` array of comments
- `401` authentication required
- `403` user is not a team member
- `404` task not found
- `500` internal error

item.name: Analytics
item.description: Aggregated SQL report. Requires team owner or admin.

request.description:
**Get team analytics** (`GET /api/v1/teams/{team_id}/stats`)

Bearer required. Only the team owner or admin can access this report, and it is always filtered to the requested `team_id`.

**Path**
- `team_id` team ID (`{{teamId}}`)

**Report**
- tasks by status
- top-3 assignees by closed tasks in the last 30 days
- average close time in seconds
- comment count per task

The report is produced by a single SQL CTE query without N+1.

**Responses**
- `200` analytics report
- `401` authentication required
- `403` only owner/admin can view analytics, or user is not a team member
- `500` internal error
